However, there is an active support incident related to a workflow stoppage after a configuration change, which needs to be addressed before considering expansion.

claims.quote: We are an existing customer in managed services. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hello [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change, and we appreciate your prompt communication. Our support team is currently looking into this issue and will be in touch with you shortly to resolve it.

Once the issue is resolved, we would be happy to discuss any expansion opportunities that may be of interest to you.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What specific configuration change caused the workflow to stop?
Have you already contacted the support team, or would you like us to escalate this immediately?
